cases.description: Verbatim SSB 5101 sentence. The bill defines 'undue hardship' itself — a self-contained internal definition, no duty modal needed to fire.
cases.sentence: For the purposes of this section, an "undue hardship" means an action requiring significant difficulty or expense.

cases.description: Verbatim ESB 5721 sentence. 'Competent' requires judgment the same way 'reasonable' does, and is defined internally by this sentence.
cases.sentence: "Competent" means the person has subject matter expertise, relevant training, and experience to make decisions and valuations relating to the amount of loss.

cases.description: Verbatim ESHB 1233 sentence. 'Unfair competition' is defined internally by this sentence, not pointed elsewhere or handed to an authority.
cases.sentence: "Unfair competition" means any net competitive advantage that a business may acquire as a result of a correctional industries contract.

cases.description: Verbatim E2SHB 1686 sentence. Must NOT flag as internal: 'private equity fund' merely contains 'equity' but names a type of company, not a contested value — a technical/financial homograph.
cases.sentence: "Private equity fund" means a publicly traded or nonpublicly traded company that collects capital investments from individuals or entities.

cases.description: Verbatim SB 5422 sentence. Must NOT flag as internal: the definition body only points to an external citation ('listed in RCW 41.80.110'), which is deferred Case 2's shape, not a self-contained internal definition.
cases.sentence: "Unfair labor practice" means any unfair labor practice listed in RCW 41.80.110.

cases.description: Verbatim HB 1820 sentence. Must NOT flag as internal: this is a duty USE of 'reasonable' (Case 4's territory), not a definition sentence — there is no quoted term followed by 'means' anywhere in it.
cases.sentence: An internet platform or network must take all reasonable steps to permanently delete the video segment.
